subject: Settlement timing for the Phase A mainnet anchor transactions of tag v0.4.0-m4
method: Read from each network's own records: zks_getBlockDetails for zkSync Era, Blockscout's batch/commitment fields for Arbitrum One and OP Mainnet. No transactions sent.
caveat: One anchor per network, all submitted within the same half hour on 2026-08-12. These are single observations of settlement timing, not a distribution.

arbitrumOne.confirmationNote: Null at collection time. Arbitrum's confirmation follows the fraud-proof challenge window, roughly seven days, which is a protocol constant rather than something this measurement observes.

opMainnet.confirmationNote: OP Stack withdrawals and dispute resolution follow the same seven-day order of magnitude. Not observed here.

zkSyncEra.executionNote: Still pending at collection time. Execution is the final step at which the batch is applied on L1.

inclusionLatency.note: The CI job's submit step covers signing and awaiting inclusion on three chains sequentially. Per-chain inclusion is bounded below by the block time: roughly 0.25s on Arbitrum, 2s on OP, 2s on zkSync.

comparator.note: Named in the Chapter 3 baselines table as the latency comparator.
